test_m2 = '''"""Tests for m2: Handle tz-aware datetimes in naturaldate."""

def test_naturaldate_tz_aware_within_five_months():
    """When a tz-aware datetime is within ~5 months of the tz-local today, return day-only (no year)."""
    import datetime as dt
    from datetime import timezone, timedelta
    from humanize.time import naturaldate

    # Create a tz-aware datetime with +11:00 offset where local date is Oct 16
    tz = timezone(timedelta(hours=11))
    aware_dt = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=tz)

    result = naturaldate(aware_dt)
    # Should be day-only since it's within 5 months - no year appended
    assert result == "Oct 16"


def test_naturaldate_tz_aware_beyond_five_months():
    """When a tz-aware datetime is more than ~5 months away, append the year."""
    import datetime as dt
    from datetime import timezone, timedelta
    from humanize.time import naturaldate

    # Create a tz-aware datetime with +11:00 offset, but far in the past (>5 months)
    tz = timezone(timedelta(hours=11))
    aware_dt = dt.datetime(2022, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=tz)

    result = naturaldate(aware_dt)
    # Should include the year since it's more than 5 months away
    assert result == "Oct 16 2022"


def test_naturaldate_naive_datetime():
    """Naive datetime inputs keep existing behavior."""
    import datetime as dt
    from humanize.time import naturaldate

    naive_dt = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 12, 0)
    result = naturaldate(naive_dt)
    # Should return formatted string without raising
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert len(result) > 0


def test_naturaldate_plain_date():
    """Plain date objects keep existing behavior."""
    import datetime as dt
    from humanize.time import naturaldate

    plain_date = dt.date(2023, 10, 16)
    result = naturaldate(plain_date)
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert len(result) > 0
'''
